description: DoD Defense Information Systems Agency Windows 11 Security Technical Implementation Guide V1R3

controls.title: BitLocker Drive Encryption Enforced
controls.description: Windows 11 system volume must be encrypted with BitLocker.

controls.title: Public and Domain Firewall Enabled
controls.description: Firewall state must be enabled across all profiles.

controls.title: Process Creation & Command Line Auditing
controls.description: Detailed process creation and command line parameters must be audited.

controls.title: RDP Network Level Authentication Requirement
controls.description: NLA must be required for all remote desktop connections.
